text: The Codex is positioned as a private universal standard rather than state legislation: it supplies legal certainty and enforceability for digital systems ranging from blockchain and AI to quantum computing, so that platforms, businesses and users can operate across borders and technologies.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Stephan D. Meyer, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886342
abstract: The UDLC is intended to serve as a private universal standard for legal certainty and enforceability in digital systems — from blockchain and AI to quantum computing — providing digital platforms, businesses and users with the tools they need to operate securely and legally across borders and technologies.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: private standard adopted by digital systems, not enacted by a legislature
